catalysts.name: AeroVironment, Inc.
catalysts.what: AeroVironment announced a multiyear IDIQ contract with a $940M ceiling for an undisclosed U.S. government customer (OPSEC restriction on naming the agency), including a ~$315M initial award for product deliveries and support under its AxS segment. The $940M is a maximum ceiling, not guaranteed order volume; no confirmed day-of price reaction found (no OHLC tape available to this routine).

catalysts.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
catalysts.what: Oppenheimer's Rick Schafer upgraded AMD to Outperform from Perform with a $600 price target - about 16% above the $515.21 FMP quote - citing 'undeniable' data-center/server share gains and a forecast of 135% data-center revenue growth in 2027. Several other desks (DA Davidson $600, StoneX $685, TD Cowen $675) reiterated bullish targets the same week; shares were reported up over 12% on the day.

catalysts.name: Okta, Inc.
catalysts.what: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced 30 Oct that Okta would join the S&P 500 effective before the open on 4 Nov, replacing Kenvue (being acquired by Kimberly-Clark); Okta moves up from the S&P MidCap 400. A follow-up report noted shares advancing ~2.5% in pre-market trading ahead of the addition on passive-demand expectations.

catalysts.name: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue ~$1.27B (+11% y/y, sources differ slightly between $1.26-1.27B) and adjusted EPS $0.27, above the ~$0.20-0.25 consensus. Raised FY2026 guidance: adjusted EPS to $1.17-1.20 (from $1.10-1.16) and revenue to $5.16-5.18B (from $5.09-5.14B). Still inside the 5-session window (day 4 of 5); re-priced this run, event unchanged.

AVAV.what: Designs and makes small unmanned aircraft, loitering munitions and related tactical systems mainly for the U.S. Department of Defense and allied militaries.

AMD.what: Semiconductor maker of x86 CPUs, GPUs and data-center accelerators (EPYC, Instinct) competing with Intel and Nvidia.

OKTA.what: Cloud identity and access-management platform (single sign-on, MFA, Auth0) for enterprise, government and education customers.

ELAN.what: Animal-health company making parasiticides, vaccines and therapeutics for pets and livestock, including the Seresto, Advantage and Rumensin brands.
